notes: Desktop 2.6.0 introduces the new Job Agent visual identity: a dark-navy app icon with a blue briefcase, teal checkmark and orange search magnifier. The icon is now used by the macOS .app/Dock and inside the Desktop header and Updates screen. GitHub Actions renders the bundled SVG into PNG and ICNS assets during release builds. Responsive layout, duplicate-application protection and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.
